00096     void timerCallback()

00098         stopTimer();
00099         
00100         String error = audioDeviceManager.initialise (numInputs_, numOutputs_, 0, true);

00112         audioDeviceManager.getAudioDeviceSetup(setup);
00113 
00114         if(bufferSize < 1)
00115         {
00116             bufferSize = setup.bufferSize;
00117         }
00118         else
00119         {
00120             setup.bufferSize = bufferSize;
00121             audioDeviceManager.setAudioDeviceSetup(setup, false);

00123
